fatal_errors: The proposed Al-Li alloy is unrelated to the target MgAlTiVFeCo BCC alloy processed by spark plasma sintering.
It omits the decisive 1000 °C SPS treatment, oxide barrier phases, densification, microhardness, oxidation behavior, and chloride-corrosion resistance.
The claimed 20% weight reduction and 15% strength-to-weight improvement have no cited evidence.
The proposed experiment evaluates only density and tensile properties, so it cannot establish the requested superior comprehensive performance involving oxidation and corrosion resistance.
explanation: The hypothesis gives a generally credible lightweight-alloy concept and names a useful baseline, composition window, and falsification threshold. However, it does not reconstruct the target material, processing conditions, microstructural mediator, mechanisms, or measured outcomes. Its specific quantitative claims are unsupported, and its tests cover only mechanical metrics rather than comprehensive mechanical, oxidation, and corrosion performance. Therefore it is not an evidence-supported alternative to the target.
